environment: Actual loopback uvicorn/FastAPI HTTP listener and isolated PostgreSQL. Gumroad traffic intercepted by httpx.MockTransport; no real provider request, buyer, product or sale.
checks: GET serves password-type license input and fixed terms, no-store/no-referrer/CSP/frame protections and HttpOnly SameSite=Strict CSRF cookie.
Missing/wrong CSRF cookie or token, foreign Origin, cross-site fetch and duplicate form fields rejected before provider verification.
Valid synthetic receipt creates one hashed paid key and redemption; raw key appears exactly once in initial HTML, alongside fixed client commands.
Fresh GET and replayed redemption do not redisplay the key; duplicate submission returns a plain already-redeemed error.
DB serialization and captured logs contain neither raw API key nor raw license; expiry is exactly 90 days after redemption, not purchase.
Wrong license/email, refunded or disputed receipt and provider transport failure never issue a key or echo secret error detail.
Two concurrent case-alias submissions create exactly one key/redemption; different licenses naming the same verified sale cannot create a second key.
Malicious email input, wrong content type and an actual oversized chunked form return bounded plain errors without issuing credentials.
reviewer: Independent coding agent. Tests are synthetic verification, not paid pre-sale evidence or independent human sign-off.
remaining_phases: Storage audit, rotation and HTTP health checks are reviewed separately in T3.2–T3.4. No deployment or host schedule activation.
